instructions.name: consume_vrf_grip
docs: VRF callback. Only the scoped VRF program identity can sign this.

instructions.name: execute_l1_prize_claim
docs: Permissionless L1 settlement for a committed claim intent.

instructions.name: execute_l1_usdc_withdraw
docs: Permissionless L1 settlement for a committed withdrawal intent.

accounts.name: machine_config
docs: The handler re-derives and validates the machine address from `machine_id`.

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Invalid odds, radius, fee, or timing parameter

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is neither the admin, the owner, nor a valid session key

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.msg: Instruction called from a disallowed session state

errors.name: InvalidSlot
errors.msg: Slot id or coordinates are out of bounds

errors.name: UnauthorizedVrfCallback
errors.msg: VRF callback signer is not the scoped program identity

errors.name: InvalidPriceFeed
errors.msg: The supplied price feed does not match the slot configuration

errors.name: NothingToSettle
errors.msg: Nothing to settle: nonce already consumed or zero delta

errors.name: InvalidOracleAccount
errors.msg: The oracle account cannot be decoded

errors.name: VrfStillLive
errors.msg: The VRF request is not yet eligible for cancellation

errors.name: InvalidVault
errors.msg: The vault account does not match the machine configuration

types.name: LastOutcome
docs: Outcome of the most recently completed round.

types.name: MachineConfig
docs: Public cabinet configuration and prize inventory.
Delegated to the ER after setup so gameplay can mutate odds counters and slot
inventory at ER speed. The layout is fixed (no realloc) so any external client
can deserialize the public odds directly onchain.

fields.name: play_fee_usdc
docs: Play fee in USDC base units (6 decimals).

fields.name: grip_bps
docs: Public grip odds by tier.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Sell-back percentage by tier.

fields.name: bullseye_bonus_bps
docs: Dead-centre skill bonus, in bps.

types.name: PlayerLedger
docs: Replay-proof settlement ledger. L1 only: never delegated.

types.name: PlayerSession
docs: A player's live ER session.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Ephemeral key authorized for gasless ER play.

fields.name: session_expiry
docs: Unix timestamp at which `session_key` stops working.

fields.name: usdc_balance
docs: Spendable ER play balance, USDC base units.

fields.name: cumulative_deposited_usdc
docs: Monotonic total deposited through the L1 ledger.

fields.name: cumulative_withdrawn_usdc
docs: Monotonic withdrawal intents settled by the L1 ledger.

fields.name: target_slot
docs: Active slot during `AwaitingVrf` / `WonPendingChoice`.

fields.name: is_bullseye
docs: Cached at drop time so the VRF callback can apply the skill bonus.

fields.name: last_vrf_roll
docs: Last roll in `0..9_999`, exposed for UI / proof transparency.

fields.name: claim_nonce
docs: Incremented on every claim request; the L1 ledger consumes it once.

fields.name: vrf_request_nonce
docs: Monotonic id of the most recent VRF request. Forwarded as callback args so
a late fulfillment for a superseded request cannot settle a newer round.

types.name: PrizeSlot
docs: A physical capsule inside the cabinet.

fields.name: tier
docs: 0 = Common, 1 = Rare, 2 = Epic, 3 = Grail

fields.name: prize_mint
docs: SPL token / NFT mint held in the PrizeVault ATA.

fields.name: prize_amount
docs: Base units transferred on claim.

fields.name: prize_decimals
docs: Mint decimals, used to scale oracle prices.

fields.name: price_feed
docs: Oracle price account. `Pubkey::default()` means "use the fixed floor".

fields.name: fallback_buyback_usdc
docs: Floor sell-back value in USDC base units (6 decimals).

fields.name: in_stock
docs: True while a capsule is physically available.

fields.name: reserved
docs: True while a VRF grip roll is in flight for this slot.

types.name: SessionState
docs: Lifecycle of a player's current round.
